title: The Square table in the corner
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：square　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 square 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the clerk wrote of ① a square table in the corner in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so square that nobody in the office would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the square ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the square table in the corner that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file for May 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too square to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the square ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a square metre of the garden, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as square as the metre of the garden they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was square or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something square, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite square; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the square ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another square table in the corner in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less square than anybody had expected. ⑩ The square metre of the garden that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the square ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 方形（前置定语 a square table in the corner：1955 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件方形的方桌）
B. adj. 方形／平方（两处加强说法：so square that … 与 no less square than …）
C. adj. 方形／平方（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 方形（表语 too square to do：母亲觉得它太方形，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 平方（前置定语 a square metre of the garden：叔叔把整件事称作一桩平方的一平方米）
F. adj. 平方（同级比较 as square as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩园子的一平方米相比）
G. adj. 平方（后置定语 something square：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 平方（受程度副词修饰 quite square：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: a square table in the corner
the square table in the corner that
a square metre of the garden
The square metre of the garden that

answers.why: square 意为“方形”，1955 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件方形的方桌”，此处作前置定语 a square table in the corner。
square 意为“方形”，此处用 so square that 结构，说它方形到办事处里没人敢靠近。
square 意为“方形”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的方形屋角的方桌，等于最高级的说法。
square 意为“方形”，母亲认为这件东西“太方形了，谁也用不上”，too square to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
square 意为“平方”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩平方的一平方米”，此处作前置定语 a square metre of the garden。
square 意为“平方”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩园子的一平方米一样平方”，同级比较用 as square as。
square 意为“平方”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“平方的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something square。
square 意为“平方”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当平方”，quite 修饰原级 square。
square 意为“平方”，no less square than 表示“其平方不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之平方不亚于任何人的预料。
square 意为“平方”，母亲 1967 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的平方一平方米”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件方形的方桌。（a square table in the corner）
它方形到办事处里没有一个人敢靠近。（so square that …）
母亲觉得它太方形，谁也用不上。（too square to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩平方的一平方米。（a square metre of the garden）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩园子的一平方米一样平方。（as square as …）
到了 1962 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件平方的东西。（something square）
answers: In 1955 the clerk wrote of a square table in the corner in the file.
It was so square that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too square to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a square metre of the garden.
He said nobody would call it as square as the metre of the garden they had once had.
By 1962 the file asked for nothing but something square.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 square 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the clerk wrote of a square table in the corner in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the square table in the corner that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too square to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a square metre of the garden, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite square, and everybody laughed.
The square ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
